revision_summary: Two targeted fixes needed on rerun: (1) Minor timestamp drift on the credit-qualifier quote in script_coverage — the '6 70' credit line lands closer to 04:52-05:00 than the claimed 04:45; adjust ts. (2) Re-examine the objection_inversion_miss classification at 04:16 and the related priority-2 coaching_focus item — the schema's objection_inversion mechanism is designed for customer OBJECTIONS (cost/time/interest resistance), not spontaneous non-resistant bill disclosures from an already-inbound, self-motivated caller. Either downgrade this from a flagged coaching priority to a lower-confidence/optional note, or provide stronger justification for why a flip was warranted despite the absence of actual resistance. (3) Fix mismatched classification labels: 'curiosity_creation_failure' is used for both the neighbor-mention moment (11:00) and the late bill-pivot moment (15:21), but neither maps cleanly to coaching_philosophy.curiosity_over_features — relabel to something schema-consistent (e.g., missed-reinforcement note for 11:00, and time_burn_detection/tech_friction_handling for 15:21, matching the correctly-cited bill_collection.alternative_paths reference). (4) Consider adding a note that the appointment was booked (07:36) before the bill was actually fully collected (~10:37-16:00), which is a process-sequencing observation relevant to the paid-lead bill-collection requirement and currently absent from the analysis.
